open.finding: .sdlc/tts-failure-handling/01-prd.md:33 — Criterion 13 tests a later turn's on_playback_finished after a max-duration no-audio EndCall, but criteria 12 and 15 require that call to have already ended; restate it as a gateway-level assertion that pending_end_call_ is false afterwards and a later on_playback_finished on the same CallSession triggers zero hangups.

02-design.md Test plan 6 (call_session_end_call_test.cpp) — The AC13 test fires on_end_call before the empty final on_tts_chunk, but the servicer sends EndCall after the terminal chunk (servicer.py:623-650), so the real wire order is never exercised; fix: run the test in both orders and assert end_call_pending() is false and the state is WaitingForHangup in each.

02-design.md Changes, CallFSM.cpp/CallFSM.h row — on_end_call_without_playback is a silent no-op in Recognizing, so a caller who speaks before the max_duration_no_audio EndCall arrives drops it without a log and the cap fires again on the next turn, contrary to AC15; fix: accept Recognizing too, or log a WARNING on the no-op path, and pin the chosen behaviour with an FSM test.

.sdlc/tts-failure-handling/03-tasks.md:11 — T1's done-when says every new Test plan 1 test must fail on base, but that includes the raising control, which is meant to pass on base (AC5/22), so the check can't be met as written; fix: require 'fail on base' only for the zero-chunk and only-b"" cases, and require the raising control to pass on both base and head.

services/conversation/servicer.py:587 — The servicer's narrowed audio_sent check is covered only by a direct unit test of _is_reply_audio (test_servicer.py:57); because the pipeline now filters out b"", no servicer-level test sends tts_payloads=[b""], so reverting line 587 would leave every test green. Fix: run one Converse turn that yields tts_payloads=[b""] with end_call=True and assert no EndCall is sent.

gateway/src/session/CallFSM.cpp:177 — The approved decision was to log a WARNING in Recognizing and leave behaviour unchanged, but on_end_call_without_playback now moves Recognizing to WaitingForHangup; a caller who is already mid-utterance gets no GoodbyeConfirm chance to cancel. This does serve AC15 and is pinned by EndCallWithoutPlayback_FromRecognizing, so the deviation should be named in the PR.

gateway/src/session/CallFSM.cpp:186 — The ignored-state WARNING prints the state as a raw int instead of to_string(state()), unlike every other FSM log line, and no test asserts this log (carried gap still open).
services/conversation/servicer.py:659 — The comment says the gateway hangs up at once, but the gateway actually enters the grace period, and the caller can still cancel it by speaking.

services/conversation/tests/test_pipeline.py:4076 — The overlap test never checks that the second request actually waited on the in-flight future, so it would pass without overlap; it is documented as a regression guard that already passes on base, because phrase_audio rejected empty results before this change.

services/conversation/pipeline.py:280 — _join_sentences only recognises the CJK punctuation 。！？, so a dropped sentence next to a CJK sentence ending in a closing quote or ellipsis (e.g. 」 or …) is still rejoined with a space.

tests/call_session_end_call_test.cpp — The gateway C++ tests (FSM Recognizing/BargeIn cases and the AC13 run in both orders) were not built or run locally because cmake is missing; CI is the only signal and must be green before the PR.
